name: comb_tournament_hamiltonian_path
statement: (n : ℕ) (r : Fin n → Fin n → Prop) (h : ∀ i j : Fin n, i ≠ j → r i j ∨ r j i) : ∃ σ : Equiv.Perm (Fin n), ∀ (i : Fin n) (hi : i.val + 1 < n), r (σ i) (σ ⟨i.val + 1, hi⟩)
closed: ∀ (n : ℕ) (r : Fin n → Fin n → Prop) (h : ∀ i j : Fin n, i ≠ j → r i j ∨ r j i), ∃ σ : Equiv.Perm (Fin n), ∀ (i : Fin n) (hi : i.val + 1 < n), r (σ i) (σ ⟨i.val + 1, hi⟩)
informal: Rédei: every tournament (indeed every semicomplete digraph) on n vertices has a directed Hamiltonian path — induction on n: given a path through the first n vertices, insert the new vertex v before the first path vertex that v beats (or at the end if none).
type: ∀ (n : ℕ) (r : Fin n → Fin n → Prop), (∀ (i j : Fin n), i ≠ j → r i j ∨ r j i) → ∃ σ, ∀ (i : Fin n) (hi : ↑i + 1 < n), r (σ i) (σ ⟨↑i + 1, hi⟩)
